responsibility: Provides shared initialization, fixup, and finalization support for GCC’s RTL loop optimizer infrastructure, and defines the pass wrappers that bracket and invoke major RTL loop optimizations. It creates or repairs loop structures, applies requested loop properties such as preheaders, simple latches, irreducible-region marking, and recorded exits, tears loop data down when passes are finished, and exposes the RTL pass objects for loop init/done, invariant motion, unrolling, and doloop. This file owns loop-state management and pass orchestration rather than any single transformation algorithm.
